agent.description: Entities, boundaries, interpretation, action, tools, and contextual capability.

evidence.description: Claims, observations, scoped independence, admissibility, evidence, recorded supporting or defeating bearing, attestations, and receipts.

governance.description: Order-relative standing, authority, grants, permissions, exercise, revocation, and enforcement.

consciousness-discourse.description: Claims about candidate consciousness conditions and Order-indexed institutional designation, without defining consciousness itself.

operational-representation.description: Representations installed into Rules and Interfaces so they can condition scoped causal paths without being confused with Reality or Evidence.

situated-world.description: Participant-scoped Worlds and contextual Substrates without collapsing access paths, Maps, or carriers into Reality.

correspondence-and-coordination.description: Materially adequate Claim-to-Reality truth conditions, accepted causal dependence on another Entity, and profile-scoped subject-target conformity without collapsing the three Relations.

adaptive-knowledge.description: Adaptive Agent-level capability, operative Record-interpreter configurations, and function-preserving reconstruction without collapsing Models into Agents or Records into Knowledge.

epistemic-status.description: Operative, factive, and independently warranted knowledge profiles without treating Records, Truth, or Admission as interchangeable.

moral-status-discourse.description: Claims and Order-indexed designations concerning candidate moral status without defining moral worth or underlying moral personhood.

sovereignty-profiles.description: Constituent, constituted, boundary-control, and external-recognition profiles without collapsing them into generic Sovereignty.

valuation-profiles.description: Preference, utility measurement, and Ledger-recorded Price without collapsing measurement or institutional status into generic Value or moral worth.

ritual-meaning.description: Participant-bound classification of an ontic Flow through memory-conditioned Interpretation and invariant-preserving target continuity, plus the Meaning Relation it causally sustains without treating targets or Records as containers of significance.
